verses.original: אָשִׁ֤ירָה נָּא֙ לִֽידִידִ֔י שִׁירַ֥ת דּוֹדִ֖י לְכַרְמ֑וֹ לִֽידִידִ֖י הָיָ֥ה כֶּ֛רֶם בֶּן־ שָֽׁמֶן׃ בְּקֶ֥רֶן
verses.transliteration: ’ā·šî·rāh nā lî·ḏî·ḏî šî·raṯ dō·w·ḏî lə·ḵar·mōw lî·ḏî·ḏî hā·yāh ke·rem ben- šā·men bə·qe·ren
verses.literal: I will sing . . . for my beloved a song of [his] vineyard My beloved had a vineyard on a very fertile . . . hill

verses.original: וַֽיְעַזְּקֵ֣הוּ וַֽיְסַקְּלֵ֗הוּ וַיִּטָּעֵ֙הוּ֙ שֹׂרֵ֔ק וַיִּ֤בֶן מִגְדָּל֙ בְּתוֹכ֔וֹ וְגַם־ חָצֵ֣ב בּ֑וֹ יֶ֖קֶב וַיְקַ֛ו לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת עֲנָבִ֖ים וַיַּ֥עַשׂ בְּאֻשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: way·‘az·zə·qê·hū way·saq·qə·lê·hū way·yiṭ·ṭā·‘ê·hū śō·rêq way·yi·ḇen miḡ·dāl bə·ṯō·w·ḵōw wə·ḡam- ḥā·ṣêḇ bōw ye·qeḇ way·qaw la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ‘ă·nā·ḇîm way·ya·‘aś bə·’u·šîm
verses.literal: He dug it up and cleared the stones and planted the finest vines He built a watchtower in the middle and dug out a winepress {as well} He waited for [the vineyard] to yield good grapes but the fruit it produced was sour

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֛ה יוֹשֵׁ֥ב יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וְאִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֑ה נָ֕א שִׁפְטוּ־ בֵּינִ֖י וּבֵ֥ין כַּרְמִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh yō·wō·šêḇ yə·rū·šā·lim wə·’îš yə·hū·ḏāh nā šip̄·ṭū- bê·nî ū·ḇên kar·mî
verses.literal: And now O dwellers of Jerusalem and men of Judah I exhort you to judge between Me . . . and My vineyard

verses.original: מַה־ עוֹד֙ לַּעֲשׂ֥וֹת לְכַרְמִ֔י וְלֹ֥א עָשִׂ֖יתִי בּ֑וֹ מַדּ֧וּעַ קִוֵּ֛יתִי לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת עֲנָבִ֖ים וַיַּ֥עַשׂ בְּאֻשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: mah- ‘ō·wḏ la·‘ă·śō·wṯ lə·ḵar·mî wə·lō ‘ā·śî·ṯî bōw mad·dū·a‘ qiw·wê·ṯî la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ‘ă·nā·ḇîm way·ya·‘aś bə·’u·šîm
verses.literal: What more could have been done for My vineyard than I have done for it Why when I expected - [sweet] grapes did it bring forth sour fruit

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ אוֹדִֽיעָה־ נָּ֣א אֶתְכֶ֔ם אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־ אֲנִ֥י עֹשֶׂ֖ה לְכַרְמִ֑י הָסֵ֤ר מְשׂוּכָּתוֹ֙ וְהָיָ֣ה לְבָעֵ֔ר פָּרֹ֥ץ גְּדֵר֖וֹ וְהָיָ֥ה לְמִרְמָֽס׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ’ō·w·ḏî·‘āh- nā ’eṯ·ḵem ’êṯ ’ă·šer- ’ă·nî ‘ō·śeh lə·ḵar·mî hā·sêr mə·śū·kā·ṯōw wə·hā·yāh lə·ḇā·‘êr pā·rōṣ gə·ḏê·rōw wə·hā·yāh lə·mir·mās
verses.literal: Now I will tell you . . . - - what I am about to do to My vineyard I will take away its hedge and it will be consumed I will tear down its wall and it will be trampled

verses.original: וַאֲשִׁיתֵ֣הוּ בָתָ֗ה לֹ֤א יִזָּמֵר֙ וְלֹ֣א יֵעָדֵ֔ר וָשָׁ֑יִת שָׁמִ֖יר וְעָלָ֥ה אֲצַוֶּ֔ה וְעַ֤ל הֶעָבִים֙ מָטָֽר׃ מֵהַמְטִ֥יר עָלָ֖יו
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·šî·ṯê·hū ḇā·ṯāh lō yiz·zā·mêr wə·lō yê·‘ā·ḏêr wā·šā·yiṯ šā·mîr wə·‘ā·lāh ’ă·ṣaw·weh wə·‘al he·‘ā·ḇîm mā·ṭār mê·ham·ṭîr ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: I will make it a wasteland neither pruned nor cultivated and thorns and briers will grow up I will command - the clouds that rain shall not fall on it

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֶ֜רֶם יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה נְטַ֖ע שַׁעֲשׁוּעָ֑יו וַיְקַ֤ו לְמִשְׁפָּט֙ וְהִנֵּ֣ה מִשְׂפָּ֔ח לִצְדָקָ֖ה וְהִנֵּ֥ה צְעָקָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ḵe·rem Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl wə·’îš yə·hū·ḏāh nə·ṭa‘ ša·‘ă·šū·‘āw way·qaw lə·miš·pāṭ wə·hin·nêh miś·pāḥ liṣ·ḏā·qāh wə·hin·nêh ṣə·‘ā·qāh
verses.literal: For the vineyard of the LORD of Hosts is the house of Israel and the men of Judah are the plant of His delight He looked for justice but saw bloodshed for righteousness but heard a cry of distress

verses.original: ה֗וֹי מַגִּיעֵ֥י בַ֙יִת֙ בְּבַ֔יִת יַקְרִ֑יבוּ שָׂדֶ֥ה בְשָׂדֶ֖ה עַ֚ד אֶ֣פֶס מָק֔וֹם וְהֽוּשַׁבְתֶּ֥ם לְבַדְּכֶ֖ם בְּקֶ֥רֶב הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w mag·gî·‘ê ḇa·yiṯ bə·ḇa·yiṯ yaq·rî·ḇū śā·ḏeh ḇə·śā·ḏeh ‘aḏ ’e·p̄es mā·qō·wm wə·hū·šaḇ·tem lə·ḇad·də·ḵem bə·qe·reḇ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Woe to you who add house to house and join field to field until no place [is left] and you live alone in the land

verses.original: בְּאָזְנָ֖י יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת אִם־ לֹ֞א רַבִּים֙ בָּתִּ֤ים יִֽהְי֔וּ לְשַׁמָּ֣ה גְּדֹלִ֥ים וְטוֹבִ֖ים מֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: bə·’ā·zə·nāy Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’im- lō rab·bîm bāt·tîm yih·yū lə·šam·māh gə·ḏō·lîm wə·ṭō·w·ḇîm mê·’ên yō·wō·šêḇ
verses.literal: I heard the LORD of Hosts {declare} Surely . . . many houses will become desolate great mansions . . . vvv left unoccupied

verses.original: כִּ֗י עֲשֶׂ֙רֶת֙ צִמְדֵּי־ כֶ֔רֶם יַעֲשׂ֖וּ אֶחָ֑ת בַּ֣ת חֹ֖מֶר וְזֶ֥רַע יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֵיפָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: kî ‘ă·śe·reṯ ṣim·dê- ḵe·rem ya·‘ă·śū ’e·ḥāṯ baṯ ḥō·mer wə·ze·ra‘ ya·‘ă·śeh ’ê·p̄āh
verses.literal: For ten acres of vineyard will yield [but] a bath [of wine] and a homer of seed [only] an ephah [of grain]

verses.original: ה֛וֹי מַשְׁכִּימֵ֥י בַבֹּ֖קֶר יִרְדֹּ֑פוּ שֵׁכָ֣ר מְאַחֲרֵ֣י בַנֶּ֔שֶׁף יַדְלִיקֵֽם׃ יַ֖יִן
verses.transliteration: hō·w maš·kî·mê ḇab·bō·qer yir·dō·p̄ū šê·ḵār mə·’a·ḥă·rê ḇan·ne·šep̄ yaḏ·lî·qêm ya·yin
verses.literal: Woe to those who rise early in the morning in pursuit of strong drink who linger into the evening to be inflamed by wine

verses.original: וְהָיָ֨ה מִשְׁתֵּיהֶ֑ם וְאֵ֨ת כִנּ֜וֹר וָנֶ֗בֶל תֹּ֧ף וְחָלִ֛יל וָיַ֖יִן לֹ֣א יַבִּ֔יטוּ פֹּ֤עַל יְהוָה֙ לֹ֥א רָאֽוּ׃ וּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדָ֖יו
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh miš·tê·hem wə·’êṯ ḵin·nō·wr wā·ne·ḇel tōp̄ wə·ḥā·lîl wā·ya·yin lō yab·bî·ṭū pō·‘al Yah·weh lō rā·’ū ū·ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏāw
verses.literal: - At their feasts - are the lyre [and] harp tambourines and flutes and wine They disregard - the actions of the LORD and fail to see the work of His hands

verses.original: לָכֵ֛ן עַמִּ֖י גָּלָ֥ה מִבְּלִי־ דָ֑עַת וּכְבוֹדוֹ֙ מְתֵ֣י רָעָ֔ב וַהֲמוֹנ֖וֹ צִחֵ֥ה צָמָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ‘am·mî gā·lāh mib·bə·lî- ḏā·‘aṯ ū·ḵə·ḇō·w·ḏōw mə·ṯê rā·‘āḇ wa·hă·mō·w·nōw ṣi·ḥêh ṣā·mā
verses.literal: Therefore My people will go into exile for their lack of understanding their dignitaries . . . are starving and their masses are parched with thirst

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן שְּׁאוֹל֙ הִרְחִ֤יבָה נַפְשָׁ֔הּ וּפָעֲרָ֥ה לִבְלִי־ חֹ֑ק פִ֖יהָ וְיָרַ֨ד הֲדָרָ֧הּ וַהֲמוֹנָ֛הּ וּשְׁאוֹנָ֖הּ וְעָלֵ֥ז בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên šə·’ō·wl hir·ḥî·ḇāh nap̄·šāh ū·p̄ā·‘ă·rāh liḇ·lî- ḥōq p̄î·hā wə·yā·raḏ hă·ḏā·rāh wa·hă·mō·w·nāh ū·šə·’ō·w·nāh wə·‘ā·lêz bāh
verses.literal: Therefore Sheol enlarges its throat and opens wide its enormous . . . jaws and down go [Zion’s] nobles [and] masses her revelers and carousers

verses.original: אָדָ֖ם וַיִּשַּׁ֥ח אִ֑ישׁ וַיִּשְׁפַּל־ גְבֹהִ֖ים תִּשְׁפַּֽלְנָה׃ וְעֵינֵ֥י
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḏām way·yiš·šaḥ ’îš way·yiš·pal- ḡə·ḇō·hîm tiš·pal·nāh wə·‘ê·nê
verses.literal: So mankind will be brought low and each man humbled the arrogant will lower their eyes

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת וַיִּגְבַּ֛ה בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט הַקָּד֔וֹשׁ וְהָאֵל֙ נִקְדָּ֖שׁ בִּצְדָקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ way·yiḡ·bah bam·miš·pāṭ haq·qā·ḏō·wōš wə·hā·’êl niq·dāš biṣ·ḏā·qāh
verses.literal: But the LORD of Hosts will be exalted by His justice and the holy God will show Himself holy in righteousness

verses.original: כְבָשִׂ֖ים וְרָע֥וּ כְּדָבְרָ֑ם גָּרִ֥ים יֹאכֵֽלוּ׃ וְחָרְב֥וֹת מֵחִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: ḵə·ḇā·śîm wə·rā·‘ū kə·ḏā·ḇə·rām gā·rîm yō·ḵê·lū wə·ḥā·rə·ḇō·wṯ mê·ḥîm
verses.literal: Lambs will graze as in their own pastures and strangers will feed in the ruins of the wealthy

verses.original: ה֛וֹי מֹשְׁכֵ֥י הֶֽעָוֺ֖ן בְּחַבְלֵ֣י הַשָּׁ֑וְא חַטָּאָֽה׃ הָעֲגָלָ֖ה וְכַעֲב֥וֹת
verses.transliteration: hō·w mō·šə·ḵê he·‘ā·wōn bə·ḥaḇ·lê haš·šāw ḥaṭ·ṭā·’āh hā·‘ă·ḡā·lāh wə·ḵa·‘ă·ḇō·wṯ
verses.literal: Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of deceit and pull sin along with cart ropes

verses.original: הָאֹמְרִ֗ים יְמַהֵ֧ר׀ מַעֲשֵׂ֖הוּ יָחִ֛ישָׁה לְמַ֣עַן נִרְאֶ֑ה וְתִקְרַ֣ב עֲצַ֛ת קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְתָב֗וֹאָה וְנֵדָֽעָה׃ס
verses.transliteration: hā·’ō·mə·rîm yə·ma·hêr ma·‘ă·śê·hū yā·ḥî·šāh lə·ma·‘an nir·’eh wə·ṯiq·raḇ ‘ă·ṣaṯ qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl wə·ṯā·ḇō·w·’āh wə·nê·ḏā·‘āh
verses.literal: to those who say Let Him hurry and hasten His work . . . so that we may see it . . . Let the plan of the Holy One of Israel come so that we may know it

verses.original: ה֣וֹי הָאֹמְרִ֥ים לָרַ֛ע ט֖וֹב וְלַטּ֣וֹב רָ֑ע שָׂמִ֨ים חֹ֤שֶׁךְ לְאוֹר֙ וְא֣וֹר לְחֹ֔שֶׁךְ שָׂמִ֥ים מַ֛ר לְמָת֖וֹק וּמָת֥וֹק לְמָֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: hō·w hā·’ō·mə·rîm lā·ra‘ ṭō·wḇ wə·laṭ·ṭō·wḇ rā‘ śā·mîm ḥō·šeḵ lə·’ō·wr wə·’ō·wr lə·ḥō·šeḵ śā·mîm mar lə·mā·ṯō·wq ū·mā·ṯō·wq lə·mār
verses.literal: Woe to those who call evil good and good evil who turn darkness to light and light to darkness who replace bitter with sweet and sweet with bitter

verses.original: ה֖וֹי חֲכָמִ֣ים בְּעֵֽינֵיהֶ֑ם נְבֹנִֽים׃ וְנֶ֥גֶד פְּנֵיהֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: hō·w ḥă·ḵā·mîm bə·‘ê·nê·hem nə·ḇō·nîm wə·ne·ḡeḏ pə·nê·hem
verses.literal: Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes and clever in their own sight

verses.original: ה֕וֹי גִּבּוֹרִ֖ים לִשְׁתּ֣וֹת יָ֑יִן וְאַנְשֵׁי־ חַ֖יִל לִמְסֹ֥ךְ שֵׁכָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w gib·bō·w·rîm liš·tō·wṯ yā·yin wə·’an·šê- ḥa·yil lim·sōḵ šê·ḵār
verses.literal: Woe to those who are heroes in drinking wine and champions . . . in mixing strong drink

verses.original: מַצְדִּיקֵ֥י רָשָׁ֖ע עֵ֣קֶב שֹׁ֑חַד יָסִ֥ירוּ צַדִּיקִ֖ים מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃ס וְצִדְקַ֥ת
verses.transliteration: maṣ·dî·qê rā·šā‘ ‘ê·qeḇ šō·ḥaḏ yā·sî·rū ṣad·dî·qîm mim·men·nū wə·ṣiḏ·qaṯ
verses.literal: who acquit the guilty for a bribe and deprive the innocent . . . of justice

verses.original: לָכֵן֩ לְשׁ֣וֹן אֵ֗שׁ כֶּאֱכֹ֨ל קַ֜שׁ וַחֲשַׁ֤שׁ יִרְפֶּ֔ה לֶֽהָבָה֙ שָׁרְשָׁם֙ יִֽהְיֶ֔ה כַּמָּ֣ק וּפִרְחָ֖ם יַעֲלֶ֑ה כָּאָבָ֣ק כִּ֣י מָאֲס֗וּ אֵ֚ת תּוֹרַת֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וְאֵ֛ת נִאֵֽצוּ׃ אִמְרַ֥ת קְדֽוֹשׁ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên lə·šō·wn ’êš ke·’ĕ·ḵōl qaš wa·ḥă·šaš yir·peh le·hā·ḇāh šā·rə·šām yih·yeh kam·māq ū·p̄ir·ḥām ya·‘ă·leh kā·’ā·ḇāq kî mā·’ă·sū ’êṯ tō·w·raṯ Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ wə·’êṯ ni·’ê·ṣū ’im·raṯ qə·ḏō·wōš- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Therefore as a tongue of fire consumes the straw and as dry grass shrivels in the flame so their roots will decay . . . and their blossoms will blow away like dust for they have rejected - the instruction of the LORD of Hosts - and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֡ן אַף־ יְהוָ֨ה חָרָה֩ בְּעַמּ֜וֹ יָד֧וֹ וַיֵּ֣ט עָלָ֣יו וַיַּכֵּ֗הוּ הֶֽהָרִ֔ים וַֽיִּרְגְּזוּ֙ נִבְלָתָ֛ם וַתְּהִ֧י כַּסּוּחָ֖ה בְּקֶ֣רֶב חוּצ֑וֹת בְּכָל־ זֹאת֙ אַפּ֔וֹ לֹא־ שָׁ֣ב יָד֥וֹ וְע֖וֹד נְטוּיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên ’ap̄- Yah·weh ḥā·rāh bə·‘am·mōw yā·ḏōw way·yêṭ ‘ā·lāw way·yak·kê·hū he·hā·rîm way·yir·gə·zū niḇ·lā·ṯām wat·tə·hî kas·sū·ḥāh bə·qe·reḇ ḥū·ṣō·wṯ bə·ḵāl zōṯ ’ap·pōw lō- šāḇ yā·ḏōw wə·‘ō·wḏ nə·ṭū·yāh
verses.literal: Therefore . . . the anger of the LORD burns against His people His hand is raised against them to strike them down The mountains quake and the corpses lie like refuse in the streets Despite all this His anger is not turned away His hand is still upraised

verses.original: וְנָֽשָׂא־ נֵ֤ס מֵרָח֔וֹק לַגּוֹיִם֙ וְשָׁ֥רַק ל֖וֹ מִקְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ וְהִנֵּ֥ה מְהֵרָ֖ה קַ֥ל יָבֽוֹא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·śā- nês mê·rā·ḥō·wq lag·gō·w·yim wə·šā·raq lōw miq·ṣêh hā·’ā·reṣ wə·hin·nêh mə·hê·rāh qal yā·ḇō·w
verses.literal: He lifts a banner for the distant nations and whistles for those at the ends of the earth Behold how speedily and swiftly they come

verses.original: אֵין־ בּ֔וֹ עָיֵ֤ף וְאֵין־ כּוֹשֵׁל֙ לֹ֥א יָנ֖וּם וְלֹ֣א יִישָׁ֑ן וְלֹ֤א אֵז֣וֹר חֲלָצָ֔יו נִפְתַּח֙ וְלֹ֥א נְעָלָֽיו׃ שְׂר֥וֹךְ נִתַּ֖ק
verses.transliteration: ’ên- bōw ‘ā·yêp̄ wə·’ên- kō·wō·šêl lō yā·nūm wə·lō yî·šān wə·lō ’ê·zō·wr ḥă·lā·ṣāw nip̄·taḥ wə·lō nə·‘ā·lāw śə·rō·wḵ nit·taq
verses.literal: None of them grows weary [or] stumbles no one slumbers or sleeps No belt . . . is loose and no sandal strap is broken

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר חִצָּיו֙ שְׁנוּנִ֔ים וְכָל־ קַשְּׁתֹתָ֖יו דְּרֻכ֑וֹת פַּרְס֤וֹת סוּסָיו֙ כַּצַּ֣ר נֶחְשָׁ֔בוּ וְגַלְגִּלָּ֖יו כַּסּוּפָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer ḥiṣ·ṣāw šə·nū·nîm wə·ḵāl qaš·šə·ṯō·ṯāw də·ru·ḵō·wṯ par·sō·wṯ sū·sāw kaṣ·ṣar neḥ·šā·ḇū wə·ḡal·gil·lāw kas·sū·p̄āh
verses.literal: - Their arrows are sharpened and all their bows are strung The hooves of their horses are like flint . . . their chariot wheels [are] like a whirlwind

verses.original: שְׁאָגָ֥ה ל֖וֹ כַּלָּבִ֑יא וְשָׁאַג כַּכְּפִירִ֤ים וְיִנְהֹם֙ וְיֹאחֵ֣ז טֶ֔רֶף וְיַפְלִ֖יט וְאֵ֥ין מַצִּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: šə·’ā·ḡāh lōw kal·lā·ḇî wə·šå̄·ʾaḡ kak·kə·p̄î·rîm wə·yin·hōm wə·yō·ḥêz ṭe·rep̄ wə·yap̄·lîṭ wə·’ên maṣ·ṣîl
verses.literal: Their roaring - is like that of a lion they roar like young lions They growl and seize their prey they carry it away and no one can rescue it

verses.original: הַה֖וּא בַּיּ֥וֹם וְיִנְהֹ֥ם עָלָ֛יו כְּנַהֲמַת־ יָ֑ם וְנִבַּ֤ט לָאָ֙רֶץ֙ וְהִנֵּה־ חֹ֔שֶׁךְ צַ֣ר וָא֔וֹר חָשַׁ֖ךְ בַּעֲרִיפֶֽיהָ׃פ
verses.transliteration: ha·hū bay·yō·wm wə·yin·hōm ‘ā·lāw kə·na·hă·maṯ- yām wə·nib·baṭ lā·’ā·reṣ wə·hin·nêh- ḥō·šeḵ ṣar wā·’ō·wr ḥā·šaḵ ba·‘ă·rî·p̄e·hā
verses.literal: In that day they will roar over it like the roaring of the sea If one looks over the land he will see darkness and distress even the light will be obscured by clouds
